trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Checked deployment history — v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever deployed to staging and was also unhealthy).
2. Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions.
3. Verified post-rollback health: all three regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
4. Opened a **SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the unhealthy deploy and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt to create the incident timed out and had not been created (verified via the incident list), so I retried successfully with an idempotency key.

**Suggested follow-up:** on-call should investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before it is redeployed.
